nodes.label: D-1 Own I3G4250D/LSM303AGR drivers, keep LibDriver BMP280
nodes.norm_label: d-1 own i3g4250d/lsm303agr drivers, keep libdriver bmp280
nodes.rationale: ST drivers return void and use global IO callbacks, so cannot report bus faults or be host-tested; LSM303AGR mag read missing. LibDriver BMP280 is handle-based with status returns.

nodes.label: Gyro bias procedure (G, SEM < 0.05 °/s)
nodes.rationale: Std error of mean rather than raw std; boot auto-cal only replaces bias if still

nodes.label: Mag opposite-heading difference method
nodes.rationale: A-B differences cancel hard-iron offsets, need no calibration, and work in either hemisphere.

nodes.label: D-4 Flash/debug with OpenOCD
nodes.rationale: Installed on bench; no STM32_Programmer_CLI needed (Q-2 default).

nodes.label: D-2 Bsp/Sensors/Fusion/App layout
nodes.rationale: Follows AGENTS.md / spec §8; vendored LibDriver in Sensors/vendor/bmp280.

nodes.label: D-6 In-repo assert harness (test_main.c)
nodes.rationale: No external dependency to pin; ctest < 5 s.

nodes.label: D-5 Debug -Og / Release -O2 / ci -Os
nodes.rationale: Spec §9.4 / Q-5; replaces CubeMX -O0/-Os defaults.

nodes.label: Headless CubeMX regeneration (§7.4)
nodes.rationale: Scripted, idempotent regeneration; diff check proves no hand edits in tool-owned files

nodes.label: D-3 Keep executable name 010_9dof_bmp280_cmake
nodes.rationale: Name is CubeMX-generated; renaming fights regeneration.

nodes.label: Host-side unit testing (§12)
nodes.rationale: Main reason to prefer CMake: pure logic compiled natively and tested at full speed without target
